data.long_meaning: The name Kamol is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Kamala’, which means lotus. Lotus is a symbol of beauty, grace, and purity in Hinduism. The name Kamol is believed to bring grace, beauty, and purity to the bearer. The name Kamol carries the meaning “Lotus” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Kamol usually hope their child will grow to embody lotus and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Kamol is considered sacred in Hinduism as it is associated with the goddess Lakshmi, who is the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. The name is believed to bring blessings of wealth, prosperity, and good fortune to the bearer.
data.etymology: Kamol belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lotus.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kamol total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
